proof_body:
by
  intro R K _ _ _ _ _ _ p q hp h
  classical
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · rw [hq]
    exact dvd_zero p
  · letI : NormalizationMonoid R := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizationMonoid
    letI : NormalizedGCDMonoid R := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.toNormalizedGCDMonoid R
    have hc : q.content ≠ 0 := by
      rwa [Ne, Polynomial.content_eq_zero_iff]
    have hq' := Polynomial.eq_C_content_mul_primPart q
    have hu : IsUnit (Polynomial.C (algebraMap R K q.content)) := by
      refine Polynomial.isUnit_C.mpr (IsUnit.mk0 _ ?_)
      exact (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective R K)).mpr hc
    have h2 : p.map (algebraMap R K) ∣ q.primPart.map (algebraMap R K) := by
      have h3 : q.map (algebraMap R K) = Polynomial.C (algebraMap R K q.content) * q.primPart.map (algebraMap R K) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [hq', Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C]
      rw [h3] at h
      exact (IsUnit.dvd_mul_left hu).mp h
    have h4 := Polynomial.IsPrimitive.dvd_of_fraction_map_dvd_fraction_map hp q.isPrimitive_primPart h2
    rw [hq']
    exact Dvd.dvd.mul_left h4 _
target_source: ∀ (R K : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid R] [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] (p q : Polynomial R), p.IsPrimitive → p.map (algebraMap R K) ∣ q.map (algebraMap R K) → p ∣ q
